description: SPIKE for the 18 directly constructed daemon suites not covered by the shared journal/resource/goal/budget harness slices. Objective: identify the smallest safe production/test seam for each of the measured 404 null-tier failures without weakening or deleting genuine ingress/admission coverage. Deliverable: one durable symbol-by-symbol migration matrix and follow-up task cuts; no source changes. NOT in scope: implementing migrations, policy resolver/validate, HUMAN_APPROVAL, or choosing tier authority. A durable task comment carries the complete 18-row matrix, counts with denominators, proposed task titles/orders/owned paths, and exact grep/probe sources so an architect can create implementation rows without re-discovery; no repository files change.

THE POSITIVE RULE, RE-MEASURED ON DISK RATHER THAN QUOTED. packages/core/src/policy/policy-evaluation.ts:59 `if (fact.tier === null || !strongTruth(fact.truthClass)) continue;` - a fact contributes only when it is BOTH tier-bearing and strong-truth. :73 `unclassifiable: computedTier === null`; :175 adds RISK_TIER_UNCLASSIFIABLE; :180 `decision = dominant(decision, risk.unclassifiable ? "HOLD_UNKNOWN" : "ALLOW")`. So with no admissible fact the honest tier is null and the decision folds to HOLD_UNKNOWN. A world that can only be built by granting an authority the product does not have is a HARNESS DEFECT, not an inconvenience.

1. HUMAN_APPROVAL MIGRATION - REJECTED. Switching a node's gate policy from POLICY_ALLOWANCE to HUMAN_APPROVAL swaps which durable witness is owed (admission-gate-resolver.ts:174-210 reads an approval record instead of a decision) and would make these suites pass by testing a different admission mode than the one they were written for. The seeder exists (`seedApprovedNodeScope`, admission-witness-fixtures.ts:180) precisely so HUMAN_APPROVAL worlds are DELIBERATE, never a way out of a null tier.
2. PolicyRiskTier SEEDING - REJECTED. No durable record carries a PolicyRiskTier: every non-test occurrence is a TYPE position in packages/core (policy-contract.ts:26/:70/:114/:133-135, approval-contract.ts:58, expansion-preparation.ts:84). Planting one into a stored event would mint a rank the evaluator never derived, and every downstream tier comparison (`tierRank`, policy-validation.ts:133) would then be reasoning about a number no fact supports.
